text:
Ravi S: Dropping a fresh draft of the launch blog intro + short email + 2 press snippets for the wire. Need a legal quick-pass, CTAs checked, and confirm HubSpot routing. Plan: publish Wed 11am PT.

Ravi S: EMAIL SUBJECT IDEA:
```
Announcing Redwood Inference: predictable, production LLM inference — webinar + try-it-now
```

EMAIL HERO (one line): Redwood Inference gives engineering teams predictable latency and lower per-request cost for production LLMs.

Primary CTA: Try the API -> https://redwood.com/signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_may2026&utm_medium=email_hero
Secondary CTA: Register Webinar -> https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_may2026&utm_medium=email_webinar

Hidden field suggestion: campaign_launch=may2026_launch (for HubSpot segmentation).

Ravi S: BLOG LEAD PARAGRAPH DRAFT:
```
Today we’re launching Redwood Inference, a developer-oriented inference platform that brings predictable latency, intelligent batching, and deployment flexibility to teams running large language models. Whether you need a hosted API, reserved GPU pools, or a private VPC deployment, Redwood provides observability, rollout controls, and cost-saving execution paths to make production inference reliable and economical. Read on for benchmark highlights, customer patterns, and how to get started.
```

Priya K: Love the lead. Quick phrasing note: swap "cost-saving execution paths" -> "cost controls and execution optimizations" for clarity. Also suggest adding a boxed link to the bench methodology.

Tara M: Press snippets submitted. Long snippet (for wire) and short embargoed teaser below.

Tara M: PRESS SNIPPET (wire, ~160w):
```
Redwood Inference launches a unified platform for LLM inference with hosted, dedicated, and private deployment options. The offering combines a GPU-optimized runtime, smart routing, and workload-aware caching to deliver consistent latency and improved unit economics for production workloads. The product includes model lifecycle controls, per-route observability, and rollout policies to reduce regression risk during updates. The company will host a launch webinar to demo real-world benchmarks and deployment patterns. More details: https://redwood.com/press
```

Tara M: PRESS TEASER (embargoed, ~90w):
```
Redwood Inference launches a production-grade inference platform with intelligent batching, KV caching, and unified routing across hosted, dedicated, and private modes. Engineered for engineering teams, it provides observability and rollout controls that make moving LLMs to production simpler. Register for the launch webinar to see benchmarks and real deployment examples.
```

Liam D: From product — please avoid raw percent claims in the hero. If we include any numbers in the blog, add a clear methodology link to /bench/methods and call out dataset types.

legal-bot: Automated check: press wire snippet length 158 words. Flag: comparative claims require methodology link.

Priya K: @legal-bot tagging legal team for quick-pass. Also adding HubSpot UTMs to both CTAs above.

legal-bot: Quick-pass done: wording approved with condition. Any performance percentages must appear only in the benchmark section with a methodology link and diagram. Avoid absolute "cost savings" phrasing without context.

ops-bot: HubSpot check: form "Launch - API Trial (May2026)" exists. Recommended hidden field: campaign_launch=may2026_launch. Workflow created: "Launch Trial Routing - May2026" -> Queue: launch-may26-sdr. Webhook for webinar registrants: https://hooks.redwood.com/events/webinar-registration is live.

Ravi S: Thanks. Final checklist before I lock assets: blog draft body, meta image (1200x630), hero quote, CTAs w/ UTMs, bench link + methods link, HubSpot form + hidden field, webhook, press CSV, and scheduled social copy. Can someone confirm meta image and hero quote?

Priya K: I’ll update the hero quote and confirm meta image by EOD. Suggest hero quote from CTO: "We built Redwood Inference to make production LLMs predictable and affordable for teams at any scale."

Liam D: Approved. Also will add a short bench callout in the blog: "Benchmarks show lower per-token cost on long-context production traces — see methodology." linking to /bench/methods.

Tara M: I’ll prepare press CSV and embargo list. Plan to send to targeted reporters after publish.

Ravi S: Locking publish: Wed 11am PT. I’ll post the final assets in this thread and ping @channel once they’re live. Thanks all! :sparkles:
